title: Brand
name: Parche
meaning: In Colombian Spanish, your group of friends and the plan you make together ("¿cuál es el parche?"). In English, a patch, like the travel patches sewn on a backpack.
wordmarkDirection: Lowercase "parche" in Fredoka, accent color, optionally inside a stitched patch-shaped badge. Final SVG artwork out of scope.
